## Honeycrumb 3: Shop Tools
The agent's tools, one `action` each. All money and rules are code (`lib-shop.js`): prices are read from **Honeycrumb Products** every time, totals are computed here, delivery fees come from **Honeycrumb Zones**, and checkout checks name, address, opening days, windows and the longest lead time in the cart before it creates the Paystack link.

One open cart per phone in **Honeycrumb Orders**. Changing the cart after checkout drops the old payment link. `payments = mock` in Settings fakes the link for tests before the Paystack key exists.
